pending_cases.reason: One captured hub declares two axle configurations; a single scalar end cannot hold both and no table exists.
OEM sheets publish lock-nut to flange distances; the engine compares ordered pairs, never sums.
The ETRTO string is free text; nothing compares it with the typed diameter and internal width.
Sheldon lists several bead seat diameters for 20, 24 and 26 inch marks; the legacy token cannot be filled automatically.
Spoke length, dish and tension are outcomes of a built wheel, never nominal facts of a hub or a rim.
